## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete issue and what changes for the user.

## Sources and scope

For clinical/reference changes, link primary sources and record their version,
review date, relevant population/units and any remaining uncertainty. For new
third-party material, include origin, license, attribution and stated changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant browser checks, including phone width/large text when applicable
- [ ] Changed clinical boundaries, missing inputs and units are covered
- [ ] No patient data, credentials or private hospital captures are included

Describe any checks not run and material limits. Code or packaging review is
not clinician or institutional approval.
